The widening confidence intervals across the different horizons are a natural reflection of increasing uncertainty as we look further into the future. Conversely, an outcome well below the 1-month lower bound of 270.5 would likely be triggered by a severe negative shock. This could include a sharp and unexpected economic recession, a major geopolitical crisis or escalation, a catastrophic natural disaster with widespread economic disruption, or a significant, unforeseen regulatory change that adversely impacts the underlying factors of the forecast.
